name: Nitrogen Survival
description:
Welcome to Nitrogen. Our server has the most loyal community in Minecraft. We're a Network that offers Skyblock, Survival, and PVP gamemodes.

We're always innovating and pushing to improve, and all community feedback gets taken into account and implemented. If you the player wants something changed, added, or removed, we make it happen.

Join today to learn all about each gamemodes features!

If connecting on console, just add us as a friend to see the server as a joinable friend!

Our IGN: NitrogenSMP
